description: Header file defining the rtRoutingTree data structure and API functions for managing routing topics and routes, supporting pub/sub with multiple routes per topic, including wildcard and instance ID handling, primarily used in rbus and TR-069 contexts.

classes.name: rtTreeRoute
classes.description: Represents a route with associated list of directly assigned topics.

classes.name: rtTreeTopic
classes.description: Represents a topic node in the routing tree, with parent, children, and route associations.

classes.name: _rtRoutingTree
classes.description: Main routing tree structure containing root topic and list of all routes.

methods.name: rtRoutingTree_Destroy
methods.description: Deallocates and cleans up the routing tree.

methods.name: rtRoutingTree_AddTopicRoute
methods.description: Adds a route to a specific topic, creating necessary nodes.

methods.name: rtRoutingTree_GetTopicRoutes
methods.description: Retrieves all routes associated with a given topic.

methods.name: rtRoutingTree_GetRouteTopics
methods.description: Retrieves all topics associated with a given route.

methods.name: rtRoutingTree_RemoveRoute
methods.description: Removes a route and its associated topic associations.

methods.name: rtRoutingTree_RemoveTopic
methods.description: Removes a topic and all its route associations.

methods.name: rtRoutingTree_ResolvePartialPath
methods.description: Finds endpoints matching a partial path, supporting wildcards and instance IDs.

methods.name: rtRoutingTree_LogStats
methods.description: Logs statistics about the routing tree.

methods.name: rtRoutingTree_LogTopicTree
methods.description: Logs the structure of the topic tree.

methods.name: rtRoutingTree_LogRouteList
methods.description: Logs all routes in the routing tree.
